title: Both lithium isotopes destroy entanglement in doped Posners

statements.text: In model calculations of lithium-doped Posner molecules, lithium-6 and lithium-7 both leave almost negligible coherence and concurrence, which does not support the hypothesis that the isotopes affect phosphorus coherence differently.
statements.conditions: The authors call the conclusion tentative, since the Posner parameters are not known.

sources.quote: For lithium-doped Posner molecules our results do not support the hypothesis that different lithium ions differently influence phosphorus nuclear coherence or concurrence
